title: Depreciation Flag Discipline Hardening

files_changed.rationale: NEW module: single source of truth for the four canonical / tax-bridge / book-pnl depreciation flag names (DEPRECIATION_FLAG_NAMES). Read-only helpers: get_depreciation_flag_snapshot, any_canonical_depreciation_enabled, assert_no_canonical_depreciation_runtime_promotion (PermissionError), get_depreciation_flag_discipline_summary (JSON-friendly). All exports are read-only.

One read-only WARN log added to runtime_flag_snapshot. If any of the four flags is detected as True, log a reviewer-friendly warning. The runtime snapshot dict is unchanged; the log is strictly informational. Wrapped in try/except so a missing D2 module does not break the snapshot.

One new disclosure row on the existing D1 Depreciation Audit sheet: D2 Discipline Phase, which reports D2 — canonical promotion BLOCKED in baseline. The summary is computed via the new D2 helper, with a try/except fallback to a static BLOCKED summary so the audit sheet never breaks.

26 new design-contract tests: inventory single source of truth; baseline factory templates do NOT enable any flag; guard fails loud on promotion (4 single-flag + 1 multi-flag); discipline summary structure; D1 sheet exposes D2 row; factory export numeric invariance post-D2 (TUHO and Oborovo pinned numeric baselines); D2 guard does NOT block test opt-in paths; rc1 frozen; 14-item hard no-go; stop-after-report contract.
10-section design + change doc with single-source-of-truth inventory, pre-merge audit summary, self-review findings, and stop-after-report contract.

self_review_findings: Initial draft wired the discipline assertion into app/waterfall_runner.py directly. Self-review caught that this would break the 57A-9D test_no_financial_formula_changes test (which treats app/waterfall_runner.py as a forbidden path). Mitigation: removed the assertion from app/waterfall_runner.py; the helper is exported and tested but not wired into the live waterfall path. The WARN log in runtime_flag_snapshot is the only runtime-touching artifact in D2, and it is strictly informational.

get_depreciation_flag_discipline_summary helper is wrapped in try/except in the D1 sheet renderer to keep the audit sheet stable even if the D2 module is unavailable in some future state (defensive design).
fix_commit_summary: Removed the assertion import / call from app/waterfall_runner.py; replaced with a read-only WARN log in app/persistence/provenance.py. The D2 helper remains exported and tested, but is not wired into the live waterfall path (preserves 57A-9D forbidden-path policy).

test_counts.full_57_arc_stack: 1194 passed, 66 skipped, 2 failed (pre-existing 57A-9E test pollution, also fails on main)

numeric_invariance.Depreciation_Audit_sheet_post_D2: text-only with one new D2 row (D2 Discipline Phase); auto-index column is the only numeric artifact

stop_after_report_contract.next_phase_start: Phase D3 (shadow validation) gated on D2 review
stop_after_report_contract.rationale: D2 is the second of the three safe next steps recommended by PR #530. D2 is purely audit / discipline; no runtime enablement, no waterfall change, no Excel export change, no UI change. User review of the new module's API and the WARN-log approach (instead of a hard fail-fast assertion) is required before Phase D3 begins.
